Plan for remote control debugging mode with JSON-RPC API over ZMQ

Design and implement a remote debugging interface that exposes all interactive debugger capabilities via a JSON-RPC 2.0 API transported over ZeroMQ (ZMQ).

Requirements:
- Implement all commands available in the interactive debug mode (step, continue, breakpoints, watchpoints, register/memory inspection, pipeline state, disassembly, statistics, reset, trace toggle)
- Use JSON-RPC 2.0 protocol for request/response format
- Use ZMQ (REQ/REP or ROUTER/DEALER pattern) as the transport layer
- Allow external tools/GUIs to connect and control the simulator remotely
- Consider async notifications for breakpoint hits, watchpoint triggers, halt detection

Commands to expose (matching interactive mode):
- step(n) — step N cycles
- continue() — run until breakpoint/halt
- set_breakpoint(addr) / delete_breakpoint(addr) / list_breakpoints()
- set_watchpoint(addr) / delete_watchpoint(addr)
- read_registers() / read_register(n)
- read_memory(start, count) / write_memory(addr, value)
- disassemble(start, count)
- pipeline_state()
- toggle_trace(on/off)
- get_statistics()
- reset()
- get_status() — halted, running, cycle count, PC

Dependencies: libzmq, nlohmann/json (or similar lightweight JSON library)
